facts.fact: MACRA said the Malawi Computer Emergency Response Team (MwCERT) currently operates under the regulator, with work under way to make it an independent institution.

note: Accreditation certificate for the Malawi Bureau of Standards; 'CERT' is certification, nothing on cybersecurity.

facts.fact: The Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act (33 of 2016, published 4 November 2016) establishes the Malawi CERT as a unit under the regulator and national coordination base for responding to ICT security threats; the Act commenced on 1 June 2017.

note: CIRT being designed; not created or operating.

facts.fact: Malawi CERT, through MACRA, publicly alerted individuals, businesses and ISPs to the actively exploited MikroTik RouterOS vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-67276, CVE-2026-86060, CVE-2026-67277) and advised patching.
The article states Malawi CERT is a specialised unit under MACRA and the national focal point for coordinating cybersecurity incidents and threat responses.
